units.source_text: 三十岁的他不知何时爱上了这样一块空地。

en.t: At thirty, he had somehow come to love this vacant lot.

units.source_text: 空地上，地面长着青苔，散堆着一些残砖碎瓦。

en.t: In the empty lot, moss grew on the ground, and broken bricks and tiles lay scattered in small heaps.

units.source_text: 可是在他眼里这与塞尚的风景画并不二致。

en.t: Yet in his eyes, it was no different from a landscape painting by Cezanne.
